implementation: Wait for acknowledged initialization, auto-start settings and successful owned session data. Preserve stored IDs until recovery settles.
Invalidate obsolete saved-ID reads synchronously on workspace, credential, authentication, preference and lifetime changes, including batched away/back transitions.
Deduplicate IDs and never automatically replay a submitted start during a hook lifetime, including uncertain failures and refreshes. Recheck owner between sequential requests.
Use acknowledged start states before saving snapshots. Serialize fresh read/merge/write operations and preserve other contexts.
Recover undispatched work after a temporary query error; retain conservative barriers on unexpected ownership responses.
Filter displayed session counts, notifications and bulk operations to the selected tenant and brand while supporting tenant-wide API lists.
